narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On September 9, 2024, at approximately 1710 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered three men at a migrant housing unit near Hart, Michigan, during a follow-up on a tip. All three stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents.
HISTORY:
One of the men told the agents that he had been deported in 2014 through Nogales; the others said they have never been arrested.
The subject stated that he crossed near Douglas, Arizona, in 2020.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
All three were processed for Notices to Appear.
